page.layout: One printed page, one text column with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top above the text. Catchword "Non" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: flatus ex nigrore & rubore: Et quidem ita, ut vel plus nigroris quam ruboris, vel minus nigroris & plus alboris habeat. Ille viridis, hic purpureus color dicitur.
Viridis color est Medius, cui plus nigroris, minus vero ruboris in contemperatione est admistum.Viridis.
Purpureus color est Medius, cui plus rubedinis, minus vero nigredinis est admistum.Purpureus.
Hae praecipuae sunt colorum Intermediorum & Mixtorum species: plures sunt pro varia mixtione.
main_text.head: Caput Nonum. DE QUALITATE AUDIBILI, SCILICET SONO.
main_text.p: Qualitas audibilis.Qualitas audibilis est, quae sensu auditus percipitur. Dicitur Sonus.
Sonus.Sonus est qualitas audibilis, in corpore sonante, quae ex corporis (praesertim duri:) collisione aut fractura, aeris potissimum refractione motuque peracta, ad aures delata, afficit auditum.

p.i: Durum requiritur corpus. Mollia enim sua commissione sonum excitare non possunt, quia unum alteri cedit.

page.notes: The running head reads "LIBRI PRIMI" with the page number 54. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible across the page and was left out. The faint marks at the lower left are not legible and were left out. The woodcut initial at the start of the Sonus paragraph is a decorative ornament, and the drop letter is read as Q of "Qualitas" with reasonable confidence. The line "Caput Nonum." and the title are shown as one head as they stand together.
